content_en.title: Villa Rental Booking Website
content_en.summary: A redesign for a villa rental agency with 143 villas around Puncak and Cipanas. Guests search by location, dates and group size, see which villas are still free, and pay the down payment from the villa page instead of checking availability over WhatsApp.
content_en.challenge:
The agency manages villas from two to forty-two bedrooms, but the old site opened with a default store list sorted by popularity, with no date or guest search. Listing cards did not show bedrooms or capacity, and every villa page ended in a single WhatsApp button, so guests had to ask about each villa's availability one chat at a time.

Important terms were spread across separate pages: down payments of 30 or 50 percent depending on the season, extra-bed and catering prices, survey fees, and a list of six bank accounts to transfer to, which made it harder for guests to trust where to pay.
content_en.solution:
The homepage leads with a search for location, check-in, check-out and guests, facility filters such as private pool or bus access, villas still free for the coming weekend, and shortcuts by group size and add-ons. Search results show bedrooms, capacity, highlights and the total for the chosen dates, and flag villas that need extra beds.

Each villa page follows a familiar listing layout: a photo gallery, highlights, facilities, a two-month availability calendar and payment terms, with a booking card that stays in view. Changing the guest count or adding catering updates the total and the 30 percent down payment, which is paid to a virtual account on the invoice. The agent works from a monthly calendar per villa with nightly prices and colour-coded bookings for paid stays, pending down payments, surveys and owner maintenance. The planned production stack is Next.js with Supabase and a payment gateway.
features: Location, date and guest search with facility filters
Villas still free for the coming weekend
Shortcuts by group size, catering, extra beds and surveys
Villa page with gallery, highlights and two-month availability calendar
Booking card with live total, extra beds, catering and 30% down payment
Down payment by virtual account on the invoice
Monthly property calendar with nightly prices and booking status

content_id.title: Website Booking Sewa Villa
content_id.summary: Redesign untuk agen sewa villa dengan 143 villa di Puncak dan Cipanas. Tamu mencari berdasarkan lokasi, tanggal, dan jumlah orang, melihat villa yang masih kosong, lalu membayar DP dari halaman villa tanpa menanyakan ketersediaan lewat WhatsApp.
content_id.challenge:
Agen ini mengelola villa dari dua sampai empat puluh dua kamar, tetapi situs lama dibuka dengan daftar toko standar yang diurutkan berdasarkan popularitas, tanpa pencarian tanggal maupun jumlah tamu. Kartu villa tidak menampilkan jumlah kamar atau kapasitas, dan setiap halaman villa berakhir di satu tombol WhatsApp, sehingga tamu harus menanyakan ketersediaan villa satu per satu lewat chat.

Ketentuan penting tersebar di halaman terpisah: DP 30 atau 50 persen tergantung musim, harga extra bed dan catering, biaya survey, serta daftar enam rekening bank tujuan transfer, yang membuat tamu ragu ke mana harus membayar.
content_id.solution:
Beranda dibuka dengan pencarian lokasi, check-in, check-out, dan jumlah tamu, filter fasilitas seperti kolam renang pribadi atau akses bus, villa yang masih kosong untuk akhir pekan terdekat, serta pintasan berdasarkan ukuran rombongan dan layanan tambahan. Hasil pencarian menampilkan jumlah kamar, kapasitas, keunggulan, dan total untuk tanggal yang dipilih, serta menandai villa yang membutuhkan extra bed.

Setiap halaman villa memakai tata letak listing yang familiar: galeri foto, sorotan, fasilitas, kalender ketersediaan dua bulan, dan ketentuan pembayaran, dengan kartu pesan yang selalu terlihat. Mengubah jumlah tamu atau menambah catering langsung memperbarui total dan DP 30 persen, yang dibayar ke virtual account di invoice. Agen bekerja dari kalender bulanan per villa dengan harga per malam dan booking berwarna untuk yang lunas, menunggu DP, survey, dan perawatan pemilik. Stack produksi yang direncanakan adalah Next.js dengan Supabase dan payment gateway.
